text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Triple Tiara, the 
Shuka Sho, is finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing news of Narita Brian's success 
reminded Hishi Amazon of just how strong 
she was. That feeling soon transformed 
into a burning fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with letters and care packages from 
her juniors, her motivation soared once 
more.
